info.title: Asterius Platform API
info.description: REST API of the developer portal. Authenticate with a personal API token (`Authorization: Bearer …`). Resource schemas (Blueprint, Action, Integration, Webhook, Team) are the same documents as the configuration files.

property.description: The `docs`-format property the Markdown came from

truncated.description: The node or edge cap was hit: the graph is partial

outgoing.description: Entities this one points to, by relation name

incoming.description: Entities pointing to this one, by `<blueprint>.<relation>`

Insights.description: DORA metrics; a metric without data has value null and no band

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: Which `docs`-format property to read (default: the first one set)

400.description: The documentation could not be fetched (invalid or blocked URL, too large, or unreachable)

404.description: Unknown or unreadable entity, or no docs property set
